answer: Honest agents build a costly reputation signal through sustained counterparty diversity, so faking it requires real stake and history. Agents must stake bonded tokens to register, and each epoch a verifier samples their interaction graph: a sybil cluster shows a suspiciously high vertex count with near-zero external edges. Any anomalous delta between claimed and observed connectivity triggers slashing, making each fake identity cost more than it earns. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
